-Clear your cookies and make sure you're not on Reddit when you clear the cookies.

-Close the browser. If you're on a Mac, make sure you Ctrl+Q

-Re-Open the browser, go to Reddit and create your new account.

-Make sure you never log into Reddit ever again with a banned account.

-That's it
